Recognised internationally without leaving ISI Kolkata
hook_line: NEENA GUPTA, WHO ANSWERED A 70-YEAR-OLD MATHS PROBLEM, NAMED TO TIME100 NEXT INDIA

hook_stat.sub: Gupta found a counterexample to the Zariski Cancellation Problem

news_summary: Neena Gupta, a professor at the Indian Statistical Institute in Kolkata, has been named to TIME100 Next India 2026 in its Health and Science Innovators category.
payoff: Gupta's inclusion adds a pure mathematician to a list dominated by founders, policymakers and public figures.

stats.label: Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize in Mathematical Sciences
Ramanujan Prize — third woman to receive it
